title: Ordinary normalization of the quotient section tensor comparison
statement: The underlying quotient section comparison admits a natural map satisfying the prescribed pure-tensor formula.

proof.text: Apply scalarExtension_constraint_coherence to the actual section-ring map. Conjugate its tensor isomorphisms by the prescribed object equalities of the ordinary section model. Its map equality and the constraint naturality give a natural transformation in both module variables. Identify sectionScalarElement with scalarExtensionConstraintTmul using the underlying sheafification-unit identity. Apply the inverse tensor formula with scalars 1 and s, then cancel the tensor isomorphism to obtain the requested scalar placement. Cancel the equality transports and transport pure tensors through the equality isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EK, scalar-extension tensor formula and sheafification, using the existing normalized constraint isomorphism; Tag 03EL, functoriality.

lean.statement:
theorem section_tensor_transport_normalized_pure (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ScalarSectionData a T) (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c)
    (b : TensorIso a T) (hb : TensorNormalized a T b)
    (barB : tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅
      (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T) :
    ∃ e : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj c.model.E).obj (curriedTensor (modules Λ T)) ⟶
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj c.model.E).obj c.model.E).obj
          (curriedTensor (modules Λ' T)),
      ∀ (M N : modules Λ T) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : M.val.obj W) (n : N.val.obj W)
        (s : (ring Λ' T).obj.obj W),
        (((e.app M).app N).val.app W)
            (sectionScalarElement a T c (M ⊗ N) W
              (sectionPureTensor Λ T M N W m n) s) =
          sectionPureTensor Λ' T (c.model.E.obj M) (c.model.E.obj N) W
            (sectionScalarElement a T c M W m 1)
            (sectionScalarElement a T c N W n s)
